name: It's All Fun and Games Until...
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
<As you tear away the single page from the Twilight Tome, a foreboding voice floods your mind, uninvited.>

They have failed.

You will be forgotten.

They will lose the eye they gained.
narrative.objectives: Obtain a Peerless Eye from a Twilight Disciple or Thug at the Master's Glaive in Darkshore and find someone in Auberdine who is willing to take it.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Thundris does not speak for some time.>This bears the mark of an ancient evil, champion. I will see it brought to Darnassus at once for further study.Ande'thoras-ethil.
narrative.requestItemsText: You look troubled. I am listening.

mentionedItems.name: Peerless Eye
tooltip: "Its lens continues to twitch, as if searching for something."
